meeting-notes-template.0: A free meeting notes template saves you from the blank page and, more importantly, from forgetting the parts that matter, which in most messy notes are the same 2 things: what was decided and who owns what next. Build those sections in. Problem solved.
meeting-notes-template.1: These templates are plain text. That means they paste cleanly into Word, Google Docs, Notion, OneNote or an email. Pick the one that matches your meeting.
meeting-notes-template.4: Most team and internal meetings? This general meeting notes template covers them.
meeting-notes-template.5: Use this when the meeting is about getting work moving, such as project syncs and standups. Actions come first.
meeting-notes-template.6: Engineering team? Our [daily standup guide](https://lynkk.ai/blog/daily-standup-meeting) shows how to keep these short.
meeting-notes-template.8: Client calls need extra fields for commitments and follow-up. Why? Promises made on the call become expectations.
meeting-notes-template.16: Structure meeting notes with the most important information at the top: decisions and action items first, discussion below. Most readers skim the first 5 lines. Put what they need there.
meeting-notes-template.19: Want a method that works with or without AI? Read [how to take good meeting notes](https://lynkk.ai/blog/how-to-take-good-meeting-notes).
meeting-notes-template.22: Type @meeting notes in a Google Doc to insert the built-in meeting notes block, or paste one of the templates above and save the Doc to reuse. Handy detail: the block can pull the event title, date and attendees from Google Calendar. No more typing them in every week.
meeting-notes-template.25: Share meeting notes the same day, ideally within an hour of the meeting, while people still remember the context. Send them the next day and they are read far less. By then people have moved on to other work and forgotten the context.
